channel.title: Daily Dose of News
channel.description: The day's most significant stories, ranked across every section.

item.title: Supreme Court hears blockbuster climate case as justices skeptical of oil companies' bid to quash suits
item.description: This case is the Supreme Court's marquee dispute of its new term and centers on a federalism question with implications well beyond climate policy: can local governments use state tort law to seek damages from companies for harms tied to conduct that occurs largely outside the state's borders?…

item.title: Drone Warfare Dominates Ukraine’s Front Line as a Trapped City Begins to Starve
item.description: A stagnant front line in Ukraine’s nearly four-year-old war with Russia has become a hellish “kill zone” ruled by drones, where any movement is met with attack from overhead, and a Ukrainian city trapped inside the zone is beginning to starve, according to NPR and The New York Times. item.title: Researcher at Russian plague institute dies of unknown pneumonia; dozens quarantined
item.description: A 28-year-old female laboratory technician at the Irkutsk Research Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East in Russia has died after being diagnosed with pneumonia of “unknown” origin, according to the Russian infectious disease agency Rospotrebnadzor. item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro wins first round of Brazil presidential election, runoff set for 25 October
item.description: Right-wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro won the first round of Brazil's presidential election on Sunday, securing 47 percent of the vote against incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's 45 percent, according to the country's electoral court.
